person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index and official Army merged file agree on the exact private identifier. The index prints Migule B. Casasres; the converted Army name field reads Migel B. Casares. Both variants are preserved, and the identifier remains withheld. The Army record identifies an enlisted private entering on April 2, 1942; occupation value 999 is left uninterpreted.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 111 and the original Army source card to establish authoritative name spelling, a safe meaning for the occupation value, a named employer, and Army-to-OSS chronology. No occupation or employer is guessed from code 999.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A direct June 29, 1944 OSS memorandum names Private Frank Cascio, describes OSS entry on June 28, 1943, and prints a private identifier differing from the index by a two-digit transposition. The index identifier resolves to an unrelated name in the converted Army file. The rare exact name, enlisted status, direct OSS context, and near identifier support a strong candidate, but the official identifier conflict prevents resolution.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Box 111 with the original OSS memorandum and Army source card to resolve the transposed identifier. The memorandum's explicit immediate pre-OSS installment-sales work remains a conflict, not a settled fact, until then.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Phillip Cascio in Box 111 with a private identifier, but that identifier has no exact match in the complete official Army merged file. Exact-name, variant-name, official, CIA, Library of Congress, OSS, employment, occupation, obituary, directory, newspaper, and archival searches found multiple namesakes without the indexed identifier or an OSS bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 111 and original service records to verify the indexed identifier and distinguish the indexed person from same-name candidates before assigning an occupation or employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Elizabeth R. Case in Box 111 without rank or a private identifier. The common name and broad official, CIA, Library of Congress, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival results lack two corroborating identifiers beyond the name.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 111 for full name, birth year, hometown, personnel status, employer, occupation, and OSS assignment. No namesake should be selected on name alone.
